title: Setka Cup and the Federation join forces for the future of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova
excerpt: Setka Cup and the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova have signed a partnership and financial support agreement to develop the sport.
body_html:
Table tennis in the Republic of Moldova is entering a new stage of development.

Setka Cup and the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova have officially signed a partnership and financial support contract, marking the start of a joint project the sporting community had long been waiting for.

The agreement formalises a collaboration meant to strengthen the competition infrastructure, support the organisation of modern, attractive tournaments and help raise the profile of table tennis nationwide. Through this partnership, Setka Cup reaffirms its commitment to performance sport and to promoting a sustainable model of private-sector involvement in developing sports.

Representatives of both sides stressed that signing the contract is the beginning of a long-term strategic cooperation focused on concrete results — in particular supporting athletes and identifying young talent, modernising competition formats and bringing table tennis closer to the wider public.

The partnership is also seen as an example of good practice and an open invitation to other companies and table tennis enthusiasts to get actively involved in supporting and popularising the sport. Investing in sport means investing in health, education and social cohesion.
